source: 1968 Chevrolet Chassis Service Manual, Fuel Tank and Exhaust Systems, p.8-8

procedures.title: Fuel lines: inspect and clean
steps: Inspect the fuel lines now and then for leaks, kinks and dents.
If dirt shows up in the carburetor or fuel pump or during disassembly, disconnect the lines and blow them out.
Check that the in-tank fuel strainer is present and undamaged.

procedures.title: Fuel line retainer clip: replace
steps: Remove the old clip from the frame.
Set the new clip in the old clip's position.
Index the blind rivet and expand it with Tool J-7777 using firm hand pressure (see figure 15 in the manual).
